Privacy

Last updated September 26, 2026.

Contacting Relevant Design

Our project email helper prepares a message in your email app. It does not send or store your form entries on this website. If you choose to send the email, Relevant Design receives the information you include and uses it to respond to your inquiry and discuss your project.

Information you choose to share

You may provide your name, business name, email, phone number, project details, and artwork by email, text, phone, or in person. Please do not include passwords, payment-card details, or other sensitive information in the project form or email.

Website hosting and external links

The hosting provider may process standard technical information needed to deliver and secure this website. This website does not add advertising trackers or analytics scripts. Links to maps, Rocket, and client websites take you to other services whose own privacy terms apply.

Questions

For questions about information you have shared with Relevant Design, contact discover@relevantdesign.cc or call (601) 736-0663. Our address is 907 Main Street, Columbia, MS 39429.
